name: All of this is mine
source:
Three arrogant heirs. One dead mother’s secret. Tonight, the bastard son settles the score.

Driven by a haunting letter, young Frederick turns the aristocratic Reltmont Halloween Gala into a massacre. Guide his unraveling sanity through a night of cold revenge.

How far will you go before your mind shatters? Play now and judge him for yourself. 

[From [url=https://santirod7.itch.io/all-of-this-is-mine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三名傲慢无礼的继承人，一桩亡母遗留的隐秘。今夜，私生子将彻底清算旧账。

在一封阴魂不散的遗信驱使下，年轻的弗雷德里克将贵族云集的雷尔特蒙特万圣节晚宴化作了一场血腥屠杀。引导他濒临崩溃的理智，穿过这个冷酷复仇的不眠之夜吧。

在神智彻底碎裂之前，你究竟能走到哪一步？立即游玩，亲自审判他的所作所为。

[摘自[url=https://santirod7.itch.io/all-of-this-is-mine]itch.io[/url]]
